card.name: Grade after improvement-to wording
card.fires_on: The word Grade (or grade) right after phrases like "improvement to", "recovery to" or "less than or equal to" in dose-withholding instructions. It comes just before a severity number such as 1 or 2.

modes.label: Return to a lower grade
modes.description: Grade follows a phrase saying the reaction must improve or recover before treatment resumes.
modes.example: Upon resolution or improvement to<< Grade>> 1, resume ALUNBRIG

modes.label: Less than or equal to grade
modes.description: Grade follows a comparison phrase setting the severity threshold for resuming.
modes.example: hepatic transaminasesreturns to less than or equal to<< Grade>> 1.

card.plain: It fires on the word Grade when a label says to wait until a side effect eases to a given severity before restarting.
